notes: CEILING: the bathroom render model has a 2.412 m ceiling (every ceiling line in p01-p04 gives 2.411-2.413), i.e. it matches the owner's 2.40 m within 1-2 cm. This differs from the work-room renders (2.61 m), so the room models were not built to one height. Heights in this file are in the render-model scale; scaling by 2.40/2.412 changes almost nothing.

Cameras p01, p02 and p04 sit outside the room (p01 1.88 m beyond the left wall, p02 0.98 m beyond the bottom wall, p04 0.48 m beyond the left wall); p03 is just outside the bottom-left corner but needs no clipping; p05 is inside. Use near_clip_m or a world clipping plane.

Focal length: p01-p04 share f = 2710 px (vfov = hfov = 50.6 deg). Vanishing points give 2702-2706 px and a free fit 2690-2750 px; changing f within that range moves the cameras by up to 7 cm along their view axis and changes heights by under 1 cm. Edge rms is 0.3-1.1 px. p05 is a zoomed close-up (about 4030 px, vfov 35 deg) and is rough (rms 3.8 px on few edges).

Window: the plan's 55 cm left-wall gap (p5-C) is a small high window (sill 1.70, head 2.40). No render shows it directly; it appears only as a reflection in the closed mirror-cabinet door, which is why the room notes describe a window above the vanity. There is no window above the vanity.
Plan item p5-A on the right wall ('radiator?', z 0.16-0.80) is the black linear shower drain, not a radiator. There is no radiator or towel radiator in any render.
Mirror cabinet: the renders put its right side at the bottom wall (z 2.54), giving the labelled 94 cm (the drawn footprint stops at 2.518). The vanity below also runs z 1.60-2.54.
Boiler cabinet: the renders match the drawing, 80 x 34.5 cm (front at z 0.414). The owner said to use the 40 cm label; the model should then put the front at z 0.47.
Toilet box: the renders match the merged plan footprint z 1.02-1.60 (the 58 label), not the narrower drawn cabinet outline (1.042-1.578).

Shower glass: panel positions come from the plan; the renders show black profiles at the corner post (0.81, 1.0), at z 0.50-0.52 on the left side and at x 1.22 and 1.40 on the front side, consistent with fixed plus sliding panels and a corner entry. Which panels slide, and whether the doors are shown open, could not be determined.

Not determined: internal shelf heights of the mirror cabinet, the exact basin model, the bowl underside height, the plank lengths of the wood-look tiles, the door swing (hinges visible from inside suggest inward).
Colours are rendered pixel values; see colours._how_to_read.
